messages:
sam: Heads-up — customer ACME reported a surge of 500 errors hitting our inference API after a scheduled KMS key rotation this morning. They saw both decrypt failures and a billing spike from repeated retries.
lee: Which key/alias did we rotate? any cross-account grants involved?
sam: Rotated alias: alias/rdw-acme-prod-key at 09:02 UTC. ACME uses tenant-proxy role to call our proxy which then forwards to KMS.
rachel: Support Ivy opened a ticket, attached logs showing Decrypt failures with AccessDenied and also a few 400s from our proxy: "Missing-Encryption-Context" header.
support-ivy: Customer says they didn't change anything on their side. They called the SDK and got KMS: "AccessDeniedException" for Decrypt with an encryptionContext mismatch in client-side logs.
lee: Sounds like the proxy might be stripping or renaming the encryption context header during the HA cutover. infra-bot: proxy deployment at 09:01 UTC rolled to v3.4.2 with header normalization patch.
security-eng: If encryption-context was lost, KMS will reject Decrypt even if grants are correct. Need to confirm whether we sent the context upstream.
sam: Repro steps from ACME: call our /v1/decrypt endpoint with x-encryption-context: {"tenant":"acme"} -> 403 from KMS. We have sample request/response in ticket.
lee: Can someone grep the proxy logs for that request id? I want to see outbound call to KMS and the body/headers.
rachel: grepping now... found outbound KMS call. Header present on inbound, but in the outbound KMS request the header is missing. Looks like header name transform: "x-encryption-context" -> "encryption-context" and proxy drop rule kicks in.
support-ivy: Customer impact: their application retried 5x, each retry billed; they sent us cost hit estimate. They've asked for immediate mitigation and audit evidence.
security-eng: Mitigation: rollback proxy normalization or add explicit passthrough for encryption-context header. Also we need an audit trail proving rotation didn't break grants.
lee: Can infra do a quick rollback to v3.4.1 in the region for that proxy pool? If not, feature flag to disable header normalization.
infra-bot: Rollback initiated for proxy pool eu-west-1 to v3.4.1 — started 2776543400, expected finish ~300s.
sam: I'll notify ACME and request they stop retries for 10m while we rollback.
security-eng: Action items: 1) Rollback proxy asap (infra). 2) Verify KMS Decrypt success for a repro payload post-rollback (sam/lee). 3) Produce audit artifacts: CloudTrail entries for Decrypt/Encrypt around rotation time + key policy/grants (rachel). 4) Postmortem if header normalization lives in mainline (security-eng).
lee: For verification, run aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --encryption-context tenant=acme --key-id alias/rdw-acme-prod-key using the tenant-proxy IAM role (or simulate) and capture response. If succeeds, we confirm header passthrough issue.
security-eng: Keep legal/compliance in loop — they may need retention records for the customer's ask about data access after rotation.
support-ivy: ACME acknowledged pause. They asked for ETA and audit logs. I gave tentative ETA 15–20m.
infra-bot: Rollback completed 2776543650 for proxy pool eu-west-1.
lee: Running decrypt test now against staging ticket payload... decrypt OK. outbound KMS call shows encryption-context present.
sam: Reached out to ACME with confirmation and logs showing successful decrypt after rollback, plus CloudTrail snippet proving Decrypt calls from proxy role. They still want root cause and a plan to prevent recurrence.
rachel: Preliminary root cause: header normalization change in v3.4.2 filtered unknown headers; encryption-context header wasn't whitelisted. Patch and add integration test.
security-eng: Assigning postmortem: sec-kms-encctx-drop. Include timeline, rollback decision, regression test, and customer cost remediation plan.
sam: Will follow up with billing on cost remediation for ACME.
support-ivy: Ticket updated and flagged for escalation to account team. ACME very appreciative of quick rollback. :thumbsup:
security-eng: Also run a sweep for other tenants rotated in the same window to ensure no silent failures.
lee: I'll script a quick scan of recent rotations and error rates.
support-ivy: Closing interim alert; keeping ticket open until postmortem and remediation plan published.
